shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -50

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat "{}"'; echo ---; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---; node -p "require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts; ls __agent_eval__

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head -30; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40
timeout 20 curl -sS -o /tmp/uikit7.md -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit7.md; timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags 2>&1 | tail -15

timeout 20 curl -sS -o /tmp/uikit8.md -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/8/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit8.md; grep -n -i "theme" /tmp/uikit8.md | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -i "theme" /tmp/uikit7.md | head -60

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue Switch SegmentedRadioGroup Button 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -l "ThemeProvider" $D --glob '*.d.ts' | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/components/theme/index.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "useTheme|useThemeValue|getRootClassName|ThemeProvider" $D/index.d.ts $D/components/index.d.ts $D/components/theme/*.d.ts $D/hooks/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -120

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/theme/types.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find $D -name 'Switch*.d.ts' | head; echo ----; cat $D/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/components/Switch/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | rg -n -C2 "Flex|gap" | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; rg -n -A12 "interface ControlProps" $D/components/types.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "export" $D/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; cat $D/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo; rg -n -B2 -A8 "Switch" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -20
cat .gitignore; echo ---; git status --short; echo ---; git check-ignore -v dist || echo "dist not ignored"
